title: AdvanceWebUI
summary: AdvanceWebUI for Cardputer ZERO upload files to the cardputer via web ui using A
description: AdvanceWebUI enables seamless file management on the Cardputer ZERO through a web-based interface. Using either an Access Point or a Wi-Fi connection, you can upload multiple files, download files directly from the device (or a connected USB drive) to your PC or phone, and install .deb packages or delete files right from the UI. The system works completely offline—no internet connection is required when creating a local Access Point.
